meta.name: prisma-postgres
meta.description: Deprecated compatibility name for prisma-postgres-setup. Use only when a user or existing integration explicitly invokes prisma-postgres; otherwise select prisma-postgres-setup.

copy.tagline: 把新项目的数据库接入配置一次配好,省去手动拼装连接的步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在搭后端项目并想快速把数据库连通
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're starting a backend and want the database connected fast

howto.what: 这是一个已弃用的兼容名称，本身不含任何数据库配置步骤。被调用时它不会自己干活，而是改为加载 prisma-postgres-setup：用宿主技能加载器读取它，或先从其 GitHub 仓库安装再继续。
howto.when: 只有当用户或已有集成明确点名 prisma-postgres 时才触发；其他情况都应改用 prisma-postgres-setup。

say.text: 继续用 prisma-postgres 这个名字，我要配置 Postgres
我现有的集成调用的是 prisma-postgres，别换名字

howto.what_en: A deprecated compatibility entry that contains no setup recipes. When invoked it does not do the work itself; it loads prisma-postgres-setup via the host's skill loader, or installs it from its GitHub repo first.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when a user or an existing integration explicitly invokes prisma-postgres; otherwise prisma-postgres-setup should be used instead.

say_en.text: Keep the name prisma-postgres; I need Postgres set up
prisma-postgres won't load, install prisma-postgres-setup from prisma/skills
My existing integration calls prisma-postgres, don't rename it
